test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ajit was born on Monday, 24 March 1980. Which day of the week was it when he celebrated his birthday in the year 2021?
solution:
Ajit was born on Monday, 24 March 1980. 

24 March 1980 → Monday

An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days.

24 March 1980 + 41 years = 24 March 2021

 
• In 41 years, there are 10 leap years and 31 non-leap years.
 
• No. of odd days in 41 years = 10 × 2 + 31 × 1 = 20 + 31 = **51**

51 when divided by 7, leaves 2 as remainder.

⇒ 24 March 1980 + 2 odd days = 24 March 2021

⇒ Monday + 2 = Wednesday

So, it will be Wednesday on 24 March 1980.

Hence, ‘**Wednesday**’ is the correct answer.
